hypothesis: Threading each directory scope's live machine-owned policy and authority path through the neutral harness makes restrictions consistent and places arbitrary agent execution behind a fail-closed OS boundary that cannot rewrite authority state or read the operator capability.

metricsCompared.name: workflow scope-policy propagation
metricsCompared.baseline: Workflow agent harness options carried static autonomy mode but no live directory-scope policy.
metricsCompared.candidate: Focused workflow capability assertions cover policy-capped autonomy and carry the resolved live scope policy into in-process tool execution.

metricsCompared.name: shared tool-policy enforcement
metricsCompared.baseline: Harness and interactive tool calls could reach ordinary autonomy and guardrail gates without scope-level restrictions.
metricsCompared.candidate: Focused permission assertions cover scope-policy denials and approvals before existing autonomy and guardrail gates.

metricsCompared.name: native harness fail-closed routing
metricsCompared.baseline: Native CLI harnesses had no declared boundary for live KOTA scope policy or machine authority paths.
metricsCompared.candidate: Native harness declarations require their sandbox or reject unsupported policy before launch; KOTA-controlled harnesses apply effect-aware guards and authority filesystem exclusions.

metricsCompared.name: opaque execution authority isolation
metricsCompared.baseline: Agent-authored shell, Node, and Python programs could address the machine authority document directly after text-based tool checks.
metricsCompared.candidate: KOTA shell, process, and REPL execution uses fail-closed macOS or Linux isolation; focused regressions prove authority writes are denied and the operator capability is hidden.

rationale: The preserved candidate extends the neutral harness/tool protocol and the existing scope-policy resolver. Fresh recovery validation passed 149 focused tests, production compilation, formatting, root layout, authority forgery, persistence, sandbox, filesystem, runtime-loader, workflow, and tool-policy checks; the prior full suite and live shipped-CLI restart evidence remain intact.
